user.title: Vesta/Climax Local Connection
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Vesta/Climax alarm panel.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your alarm panel (e.g., 192.168.1.100)
data_description.username: The username for your alarm panel (usually 'admin')
data_description.password: The password for your alarm panel

zeroconf_confirm.title: Vesta/Climax Panel Discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: A Vesta/Climax alarm panel ({name}) was discovered at {host}. Enter the credentials to complete setup.

data_description.username: The username for your alarm panel (usually 'admin')
data_description.password: The password for your alarm panel

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Vesta/Climax Panel
reauth_confirm.description: Authentication failed for {host}. Please enter your new credentials.

init.title: Vesta/Climax Local Options
init.description: Update the credentials for your Vesta/Climax alarm panel and choose whether camera photos are saved.

data.save_captures: Save camera photos to a folder

data_description.save_captures: The panel keeps the photos in temporary memory and loses them when it restarts. When enabled, every photo is saved as <folder>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<HHMMSS>_zone<N>_<n>.jpg.
data_description.capture_dir: Absolute path inside Home Assistant. Add its parent to media_dirs to browse the photos in Media.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the panel. Please check the host address and network connection.
error.capture_dir_not_writable: The folder cannot be created or written.
